home.metaTitle: Dimah Starter — Next.js Starter for Multi-Tenant SaaS
home.headline: A server-first <accent>starter</accent> for multi-tenant SaaS
home.lede: Start from a working app, not a blank page. Auth, organizations, admin, and file uploads on Next.js, Better Auth, and Postgres — with i18n and RTL built in.
home.demoHint: Sign up with email or Google to explore the dashboard.

features.title: Everything a SaaS needs on day one
features.description: The product surface is already built, so you can spend your time on what makes yours different.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: Email or Google sign-in, email verification, and password reset.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.description: Invite members by email and give each one a role.

admin.title: Admin panel
admin.description: Manage users, bans, and platform roles in one place.

storage.title: File uploads
storage.description: Avatars and logos on any S3-compatible bucket with dimah-s3.

i18n.title: i18n and RTL
i18n.description: English and Persian out of the box, with right-to-left layouts.

serverFirst.title: Server-first
serverFirst.description: Session in Server Components, cached reads, and a Server Action for every write.

quickStart.title: Up and running in minutes
quickStart.description: Install, configure, and run. The README covers deployment and every environment variable.
